title: Pase adelante
desc: Being invited in and not being able to refuse
setting: You knock to return a borrowed tool. Doña Carmen opens the door and the tool is suddenly beside the point.

options.es: Solo vine a dejarle esto, doña.
options.en: I only came to drop this off for you, doña.
options.feedback: Says why you came without refusing her. It leaves her room to insist, which she will.

options.en: Thank you, I will come in for a moment.
options.feedback: Accepting is right. The moment will not be a moment.
A flat no at the door is heard as a refusal of her, not of the time.

steps.speaker: Doña Carmen
steps.es: Ay, no, entre un ratito. Ya hice café.
steps.en: Oh no, come in for a little while. I have just made coffee.

options.en: All right, a little while then. Thank you.
options.feedback: She insisted once, which is the signal. You accepted at exactly the right point.
Accepted, if a little transactional. It is not really about the coffee.
Turning down a second offer needs a reason she can carry to somebody else.

steps.speaker: Doña Carmen
steps.en: Sit down then. How is work going?

options.es: Ahí va, doña. Con calor pero ahí va.
options.en: It is going, doña. Hot, but it is going.
options.feedback: Ahí va is the answer people here actually give, and you kept the heat in it.
Correct. Ahí va is what people here actually answer.
Too much for the first minute. Save that for the gate on the way out.

steps.speaker: Doña Carmen
steps.es: Aquí siempre tiene su casa, mijo.
steps.en: You always have a home here, son.

options.es: Gracias, doña. Eso lo tomo en serio.
options.en: Thank you, doña. I take that seriously.
options.feedback: You heard that it was not a formula, and you said so.
Polite, but it answers a courtesy rather than what she actually said.

options.en: All right, I am leaving now.
options.feedback: She said something large. Leaving on top of it is the one wrong move.
